name: com.streethawk.library.StreethawkBroadcastReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this receiver for boot, time-zone, network, Bluetooth, location-provider, and StreetHawk notification-response events. It resumes or stops background location and beacon work and queues related SDK status reports.
disableEffect: StreetHawk background tracking, beacon monitoring, and campaign responses will no longer update after these events.
